anchor.problem: Post-CTS datapath placement moves can induce hold repairs competing for legal physical resources.
anchor.engineering_user: Implementation engineer deciding bounded datapath cell relocations after CTS and initial global route.
anchor.downstream_need: Improve final extracted setup slack without new hold, physical or functional failures while charging total iteration cost.
anchor.causal_mechanism: Represent action-conditioned concrete hold-repair alternatives with shared coverage and conflicting occupancy/connection footprints; select and validate placement plus compensating repair jointly before retention.
mechanism_invariants: Fixed initial clock cells/connectivity, die, constraints and technology; no retiming or functional logic change.
Primary intervention remains bounded datapath cell relocation; repairs are declared buffer chains and bounded legalization.
Repair options are keyed to the full candidate placement/checkpoint and invalidated after changes.
Joint occupancy and net-split constraints include shared-buffer coverage; scalar counts are insufficient.
Whole-design min/max and final physical validation remain mandatory; table exactness is not signoff.
Charge generation, all failed checks, rollback, rerouting and fallback under matched budgets.
forbidden_pivots: Claiming generic agents, whitespace reservation, rollback, MILP or hold-aware contest extensions as the contribution.
Replacing the anchored interface with script automation, a generic timing predictor, pin-access residual compilation or unrelated clock/logic optimization.
Optimizing HPWL/GR proxy alone or weakening hold/DRC/functional safety to claim success.
